about: Coverage frame of the AI Safety Policy Register: every jurisdiction and source type the pipeline searches, with when each cell was last searched. Maintained by tools/pipeline.py (frame, dedupe); see AGENTS.md section 7.1.

source_types.legislature: parliament or assembly: bills, acts, committee pages
source_types.gazette: official gazette or official law database
source_types.executive: head of state or government, cabinet, council of ministers: decrees, orders, decisions, strategies
source_types.ministries: ministries or agencies for digital affairs, science and technology, justice (state agencies for sub-national)
source_types.ai-bodies: AI-specific regulators, AI offices and AI safety or security institutes
source_types.elections: election authorities: rules on AI and synthetic media in campaigns
source_types.repository: the body's own document repository, declarations and resolutions
source_types.supervisors: supervisory authorities, sectoral (banking and financial services, insurance and pensions, securities, health and medicines) and horizontal (data protection, equality and anti-discrimination, consumer protection, competition): AI guidelines, opinions, supervisory statements, Q&As, sector-wide letters and thematic reviews

jurisdictions.name: ISO/IEC (International Organization for Standardization and International Electrotechnical Commission), JTC 1/SC 42
CEN and CENELEC (European Committee for Standardization and European Committee for Electrotechnical Standardization), JTC 21
